profile.headline: Software Engineer at Houzz - Visual Technologies Team
profile.summary: I am a graduate of the University of Pennsylvania's School of Engineering and Applied Science, with a focus on computer graphics, 3D tool development, and procedural rendering. I received my MSE in Computer Graphics and Game Technology and BSE in Digital Media Design. Come check out my work at: www.alexis-ward.tech

positions.title: Teaching Assistant - Introduction to Computer Graphics
positions.description:
♣	Assisted a professor in teaching 70 undergraduate and graduate students the technical aspects of 3D Modeling including viewing transformations, polygon and mesh data structures, keyframe animation, and interactive manipulation – using C++ and OpenGL
♣	Hosted office hours and graded student homework and exams

positions.title: Website Designer - Visualizing the Past Website
positions.description:
♣	Created a website to showcase student projects for the class Visualizing the Past / Peopling the Past
♣	Altered and retextured most student models for display

positions.title: Teaching Assistant - Introduction to Computer Programming
positions.description:
♣	Assisted in teaching 250 students the fundamentals of computer programming in Java, with emphasis on applications in science and engineering, as well as the broader field of computer science and algorithmic thinking
♣	Aided students with debugging and conceptual explanations during office hours
♣	Constructed and graded student homework and exams

positions.title: Wantagh TechDay Instructor
positions.description: Taught web development through basic computer science concepts, such as iteration and conditional statements, to thirty middle school students using C, JavaScript, and HTML

projects.title: Ecosystem Creator
projects.description:
• Houdini plug-in based on Synthetic Silviculture: Multi-scale Modeling of Plant Ecosystems
• Allows plants to react to their environment at a branch level, modeling realistic growth

projects.title: Medical Imaging Software
projects.description:
• A high-speed, interactive DICOM viewer that allows for both 2D and 3D analysis of scans
• Can display CT, MRI, and ultrasound scans from selected files or directories
